instructions_to_main_agent: Retain 100% of all existing API endpoints, dialogs (Add/Edit Equipment modal, Types modal, Log Maintenance/Replacement dialog with camera support, Documents modal with photo/certification categories, MaintenanceProfile component).

Replace the cramped 7 icon buttons in each row with the modern high-ergonomics action bar: Primary 'Log' (Emerald pill) + 'Docs (N)' (Slate pill with count badge) + DropdownMenu (Radix Kebab) containing QR Profile, Replacement, Edit, and Delete.

Upgrade top 4 stat cards into interactive Quick-Filter KPI tiles: clicking 'Maintenance Overdue' applies overdue filter to the list; clicking 'Due in 30 Days' filters due soon; clicking 'Order Now' filters items within procurement lead time; clicking 'Total Equipment' or active card resets back to all.
Add an Active Filter Tag bar below search & dropdowns when any filter or KPI quick-filter is active, showing item count and a one-click 'Clear all' button.
Ensure hierarchy tree indentation is visually elegant with clean connecting lines (└) and clear assembly parent/child badges.
Ensure all existing data-testid attributes are strictly preserved for automated QA regression testing.
Ensure dark mode contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit hover and focus text colors.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing (p-6 to p-8 container, p-4 on cards, gap-4 on grids). Prevent text collisions with proper padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.touch_targets: Minimum 36px to 40px clickable targets for all buttons and interactive dropdown triggers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Always explicitly define hover colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900). Never rely on transparent header/dialog backdrops.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast for action feedback (toast.success, toast.error).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. No emojis as icon substitutes.
